evidence.name: Screen field: Slide content template
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Slide content template" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Slide content template
sections.description: Sets which layers each slide shows: Image Only is just the picture, Image + Title adds one headline, Image + Title + Subtitle adds a supporting line, and Image + Title + 2 Subtitles shows all four text layers. Choosing a richer template reveals its matching text and style fields below. Default to Image + Title for clean, fast-reading slides and add subtitles only when each slide genuinely needs more copy.
